question: What arises in the third and later tuṭis?
premises: that same śakti of śiva is said
mantra-lords and their śaktis arise in order
inference: Later tuṭis manifest ordered mantra-lords and their śaktis.
plain_english: That same Śakti of Śiva is said; in the third and later tuṭis, mantra-lords and their śaktis and so on arise in order.
